item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Frankie Goes to Hollywood - Welcome to the Pleasuredome (Steven Wilson Mix) (Dolby Atmos)
item.description: Does anyone have the actual Dolby Atmos mix of Frankie Goes to Hollywood's 1984 album Welcome to the Pleasuredome? I can't find a rip of it anywhere. I believe it's on the Blu-Ray included with the 7CD box-set and it might also be on Tidal with the subtitle "Steven Wilson Mix", as per the thread title. Thanks in advance.
